senses.gloss: m. (תְּרַע I) one that makes a breach.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69">Gen. R. s. 69</cite> (play on <he>ופרצת ימה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 28:14">Gen. XXVIII, 14</cite>) <he>את הוא ת׳ דימא</he> (some ed. <cite ref="V00968"><he>תְּרוֹעָיָיא</he></cite>) thou art he that will break through the sea (thy children will pass through the Red Sea); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 551:10">Yalk. Mic. 551</cite> <he>תרעא</he> (corr. acc.).
